ALTER PROC [OM].[SP_TASK_START] @task_name [varchar](100),@pipeline_runid [VARCHAR](50),@data_layer [nvarchar](150),@process_date [datetime] AS

BEGIN

		BEGIN

			DECLARE @FLAG_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
			DECLARE @FLAG_INIT_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
			DECLARE @FLAG_SUC_LATER_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
			DECLARE @FLAG_CHK_PREV_DAY_SUCC [NUMERIC](15,0)
			DECLARE @FLAG_CHK_BUS_DAY [NUMERIC](15,0)


			SELECT 
				@FLAG_INIT_CNT=COUNT(*) 
			FROM 
				(SELECT TOP 1 TASK_NAME FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE
				TASK_NAME=UPPER(@task_name) AND PROCESS_DATE < @process_date ) OTR
				
			SELECT 
				@FLAG_SUC_LATER_CNT=COUNT(*) 
			FROM 
				OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
			INNER JOIN
				OM.OM_TASKS OT 
				ON
				OTR.TASK_NAME = OT.TASK_NAME
			INNER JOIN
				OM.OM_STATUS OS
				ON
				OS.STATUS_ID=OTR.STATUS_ID
			WHERE
				(OS.STATUS='SUCCESSFUL' AND OT.TABLE_TYPE = 'SCD TYPE 2')
				AND OTR.TASK_NAME=UPPER(@task_name) 
				AND OTR.PROCESS_DATE > @process_date


			/*SELECT --REMOVED RTSF 2024-10-01
				@FLAG_CNT=COUNT(*) 
			FROM 
				EDS.DATE_DIM DD
			INNER JOIN
				OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
				ON
				DD.FULLDATE=@process_date
				AND 
				DD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY=OTR.PROCESS_DATE
			INNER JOIN
				OM.OM_TASKS OT 
				ON
				OTR.TASK_NAME = OT.TASK_NAME
			INNER JOIN
				OM.OM_STATUS OS
				ON
				OS.STATUS_ID=OTR.STATUS_ID
			WHERE
				(OS.STATUS<>'SUCCESSFUL' AND OT.TABLE_TYPE = 'SCD TYPE 2')
				AND OTR.TASK_NAME=UPPER(@task_name)*/


			IF((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM OM.OM_TASKS where TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name) AND TABLE_TYPE = 'SCD TYPE 2' AND DATA_LAYER IN ('EDS_STG','STG_EDS') AND COALESCE(ON_DEMAND,'N') = 'N' )>0) --UPDATED RTSF 2024-09-26, UPDATED RTSF 2024-10-01
        
				SELECT 
		    	@FLAG_CHK_PREV_DAY_SUCC=COUNT(*) 
                
				FROM 
					EDS.DATE_DIM DD
                INNER JOIN
            	    OM.OM_TASKS OT
            	    ON 1=1
				INNER JOIN 
					OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
					ON
					DD.FULLDATE=@process_date
					AND 
                    OTR.TASK_NAME = OT.TASK_NAME
                    AND
					CASE WHEN FREQUENCY_LOADING = 'DAILY' THEN DATEADD(DD,-1,DD.FULLDATE) 
						 WHEN FREQUENCY_LOADING = 'WEEKDAYS' AND MONTHEND = 'Y' AND MONTH_END = 'Y' THEN DD.PREVIOUS_MONTH_LAST_BUS_DAY 
                         WHEN FREQUENCY_LOADING = 'WEEKDAYS' THEN DD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY 
                         ELSE NULL END=OTR.PROCESS_DATE
				INNER JOIN
					OM.OM_STATUS OS
					ON
					OS.STATUS_ID=OTR.STATUS_ID
                INNER JOIN 
                    OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY OTD
                    ON
                    OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = OTR.TASK_NAME
				WHERE
            	    OTD.TASK_NAME=UPPER(@task_name) 
            	    AND OS.STATUS='SUCCESSFUL'
            	    AND OT.TABLE_TYPE='SCD TYPE 2'
                    
                    

            ELSE IF((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM OM.OM_TASKS where TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name) AND TABLE_TYPE = 'SCD TYPE 2' AND DATA_LAYER ='EDS' AND COALESCE(ON_DEMAND,'N') = 'N')>0) --UPDATED RTSF 2024-09-26, UPDATED RTSF 2024-10-01      
            
                SELECT 
		    	@FLAG_CHK_PREV_DAY_SUCC=COUNT(*) 
	            
				FROM 
					EDS.DATE_DIM DD
                INNER JOIN
            	    OM.OM_TASKS OT
            	    ON 1=1
				INNER JOIN --UPDATED RTSF 2024-10-01
					OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
					ON
					DD.FULLDATE=@process_date
                    AND
                    OTR.TASK_NAME = OT.TASK_NAME
                    AND
					CASE WHEN OT.FREQUENCY_LOADING = 'DAILY' THEN DATEADD(DD,-1,DD.FULLDATE) 
						 WHEN OT.FREQUENCY_LOADING = 'WEEKDAYS' AND OT.MONTHEND = 'Y' AND DD.MONTH_END = 'Y' THEN DD.PREVIOUS_MONTH_LAST_BUS_DAY 
                         WHEN OT.FREQUENCY_LOADING = 'WEEKDAYS' THEN DD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY 
                         ELSE NULL END=OTR.PROCESS_DATE
				INNER JOIN
					OM.OM_STATUS OS
					ON
					OS.STATUS_ID=OTR.STATUS_ID	
				WHERE
            	    OTR.TASK_NAME=UPPER(@task_name)
            	    AND OS.STATUS='SUCCESSFUL'
            	    AND OT.TABLE_TYPE='SCD TYPE 2'
                    AND OT.SOURCE_CODE NOT IN ('DID')

			ELSE 
    			SELECT @FLAG_CHK_PREV_DAY_SUCC = 1

			
			IF((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM OM.OM_TASKS where TASK_NAME =  @task_name AND FREQUENCY_LOADING = 'WEEKDAYS' )>0)

			    SELECT @FLAG_CHK_BUS_DAY=COUNT(*)
			    FROM 
					EDS.DATE_DIM DD
				WHERE
			        DD.Business_Day_Flag = 'Y'
			        AND DD.FULLDATE=@process_date
					

			IF((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM OM.OM_TASKS where TASK_NAME =  @task_name AND FREQUENCY_LOADING = 'DAILY' )>0)
			    SELECT @FLAG_CHK_BUS_DAY=1





			IF(@FLAG_SUC_LATER_CNT>0)
			   BEGIN

				   DECLARE @errmsg1 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'JOB '+@task_name+' WAS EXECUTED SUCCESSFULLY ON A LATER PROCESS DATE. TERMINATING EXECUTION. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE';   

                   EXEC OM.SP_LOG_TASK_ERROR_DTL @pipeline_runid, @task_name, @data_layer, @process_date, @errmsg1;
                   
				   THROW 60000, @errmsg1, 1;  
			   END
			   
			/*IF(@FLAG_CNT>0 AND @FLAG_INIT_CNT>0)  --REMOVED RTSF 2024-10-01
			   BEGIN

				   DECLARE @errmsg2 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'CURRENT JOB '+@task_name+' STATUS IS NOT YET SUCCESSFUL FOR LATEST BUSINESS DATE IN EDS_CTL TABLE. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE';   
  
				   THROW 60001, @errmsg2, 1;  
			   END*/

			IF(@FLAG_CHK_PREV_DAY_SUCC<1 AND @FLAG_INIT_CNT>0)
			   BEGIN

				   DECLARE @errmsg3 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'CURRENT JOB '+@task_name+' STATUS IS NOT YET SUCCESSFUL FOR THE PREVIOUS BUSINESS DATE IN EDS_CTL TABLE. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE';   

                   EXEC OM.SP_LOG_TASK_ERROR_DTL @pipeline_runid, @task_name, @data_layer, @process_date, @errmsg3;
  
				   THROW 60002, @errmsg3, 1;  
			   END

			IF(@FLAG_CHK_BUS_DAY<1)
			   BEGIN

				   DECLARE @errmsg4 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'CURRENT JOB '+@task_name+' PROCESS DATE IS NOT A BUSINESS DAY. PLEASE CHECK EDS.DATE_DIM AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE';   

                   EXEC OM.SP_LOG_TASK_ERROR_DTL @pipeline_runid, @task_name, @data_layer, @process_date, @errmsg4;
  
				   THROW 60003, @errmsg4, 1;  
			   END

		END

  
	   BEGIN
			DELETE
			FROM 
				[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] 
			WHERE
				TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name) AND
				PROCESS_DATE = @process_date AND
				STATUS_ID NOT IN (SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL' OR STATUS = 'FOR RE-EXECUTION')
				
		   ---START TASK
			INSERT INTO 
			[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] 
			(
				TASK_RUN_ID,
				TASK_NAME,
				PIPELINE_RUNID,
				STATUS_ID,
				DATA_LAYER,
				PROCESS_DATE,
				START_DATETIME,
				END_DATETIME,
				CREATE_DATETIME
			)
			SELECT  
				 concat(@pipeline_runid,'-',UPPER(@task_name))
				,UPPER(@task_name)
				,@pipeline_runid
				,(SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS = 'RUNNING')
				,UPPER(@data_layer)
				,@process_date
				,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
				,NULL
				,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)		
	   END
	
END
